questions.teachingTopic: 根据文本证据作合理推断
questions.stem: Researchers studying mobile produce markets collected data during both routine conditions and unusually demanding conditions. During routine conditions, the groups differed little. During demanding conditions, however, weekly stops increased fresh-food purchases in neighborhoods far from supermarkets. The researchers did not change any other part of the procedure. Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.C: The finding demonstrates that routine conditions never affect any outcome.
options.D: The researchers should assume that the factor has exactly the same effect in all conditions.
